sentinelValues.meaning: 4D user account: always return the 4D user account name (constant '4D user account')
4D user alias: return the alias defined with SET USER ALIAS, or an empty string if none is defined (constant '4D user alias')
4D user alias or account (default if omitted): return the alias if one is defined with SET USER ALIAS, otherwise the regular account name (constant '4D user alias or account')
